notes.title: SMASH BALL QUICK PITCH
notes.notes:
[b]GET SMASHED!![/b]

Introducing...Smash Ball! The fast-paced destructive sports game of the future! Smash Ball is an action
packed sports game that allows you to build a team of Mechletes to compete and become the best in the
galaxy!

Smash Ball features 1v1, 2v2, versus and co-op online and local play.
Build a team and fight against online players or team up with your friends to work together to get to the
top. Conquer together a wide range of online Tournaments and collect Mech League Trophies for your
Team's Prize Vault.

Use skill to master Boom Ball power shots, Shield block timing, and Dash smashes to dominate your
opponents!

Play through a single player campaign to learn more about the Mech League and uncover the scheming
plans of the League Manufacturers.

Collect Prize Bots to unlock new parts and prizes. Upgrade your team of mechletes and tailor your
playstyle to fit your desire to score...or destroy!

[b][i]Smash Ball! Champions aren't just made, they're built![/i][/b]
[b]
About the Developer:[/b]
We are Game Pill, a dedicated team of experienced game developers who are excited to bring to
you a new and a unique gaming experience with every title we make. We work hard and take pride in
the games we build and strive to bring you quality entertainment worthy of your time and hard earned
dollar.

If you want to join our growing community and share your voice with us, download the Smash demo and
join us for our upcoming Beta. 

Check us out at https://smashballgame.com/ and join our Discord! 
We love to engage with our community and would love to hear what you like (or what you think can be
better)!

Thank you for choosing to Smash Ball with us, enjoy the festival!

notes.title: ☄️ 🦾WATCH US STREAM SMASH BALL! 🤖
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33432580/96074718fcb15ca54a65868b90bbb2fad66bdde2.png[/img]

SMASH BALL is a high-speed action sports game for PC, console and mobile. 
 
SMASH BALL can be played with or against friends in a 1v1 / 2v2 hybrid of arcade-style ping pong played with customizable mech athletes. 

Destroy your opponents LITERALLY.  Launch rockets, throw sticky bombs, anything goes in the SMASH BALL arena if it means winning. 

Customize your parts to suit your playstyle.  Manage your team, resources, and booster cards to retain sponsors, 
grow your fan base and win.
